content.markdown:
# Shunt Dynamics

Shunt dynamics is the universal mechanism that drives all interactions in SDT.

## The Three Stages

### 1. RESISTANCE

When spations encounter matter (displacement), they resist compression.

- Pressure builds up
- Energy accumulates
- System prepares for transfer

### 2. RECOIL

The accumulated energy causes a recoil motion.

- Energy releases
- Motion begins
- Direction determined by geometry

### 3. TRANSFERENCE

Energy and momentum transfer to the next spation.

- Energy flows
- Motion propagates
- Cycle repeats

## Physical Significance

Shunt dynamics explains:

- How forces emerge from pressure gradients
- How energy transfers through the system
- How motion propagates through space
- How time emerges from counting events

## Mathematical Formulation

The circulation $\Gamma$ emerges from shunt dynamics:

$$\Gamma = \frac{\text{shunt events}}{\text{unit time}}$$

This circulation drives energy transfer in the master equation.
